title_en: Xi Jinping and Russian President Putin Visit Photo Exhibition on China-Russia Friendship
summary_zh: 5月20日晚，国家主席习近平与俄罗斯总统普京在北京人民大会堂共同参观中俄友好主题图片展。
summary_en: On the evening of May 20, President Xi Jinping and Russian President Putin jointly visited a photo exhibition on China-Russia friendship at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.
